EnvId.description:
Identifies one materialisation of a unit. A unit re-materialised after reclaim
gets a new environment, not a new unit.

PortName.description: The name a recipe gives a port, for example `app` or `api`.

ProjectId.description: Identifies a project: one Git repository Nodal manages units for.

description:
One port an environment holds, under the name the recipe gave it.

The port is the identity of the row. Two environments cannot hold one port, and an
environment holds one port per name.

name.description: What the recipe calls this port, for example `app`.

project_id.description: The project whose block the port came from.

title: PortAllocation
